idea-plugin.name: Quxlang Syntax
idea-plugin.description: Syntax highlighting for Quxlang source files, including keywords, built-in types, literals, documentation blocks, member accesses, parameter declarations, named arguments, local declarations, and calls. Colors are configurable under Editor | Color Scheme | Quxlang. File-local scope lookup colors arguments, local variables, globals, and declared functions and supports Go to Declaration. Dependent templates, overload selection, imports, and inferred types remain unresolved. Function-call colors apply only to the call parentheses.
